artifacts.summary: Decides R1 (plan-declared, additive new plan section) over R2 (git extraction) for the trusted Challenge source, designs lean-challenge-snapshot.sh's commit-and-manifest immutability mechanism, and recommends a Statement Fidelity clause for plan-compliance.md.

memory_candidates.content: lean-comparator-run.sh's --commit REF checks out ONE git worktree containing both Challenge and Solution modules at that single commit -- it never synthesizes .lean file content itself, only a lakefile.toml declaring lean_lib targets when not already declared. Any Challenge-producing tool must therefore commit real .lean source into the target project's own git history and hand callers a SHA; immutability comes from git history, not filesystem permissions.

plan-format.md already has precedent for a conditionally-present top-level plan section (## Planned Strategic Sorries, gated on plan_metadata.skeleton). When a task-type-specific plan extension is needed, add a new additively-gated section rather than amending a shared field like **Goals**: that every task type's format contract depends on -- this keeps the change provably inert for unrelated task types.
